independentReview.status: no remaining actionable source findings after repeated review/fix cycles
acceptedFindings: State creates are relative to held native roots; canonical strings do not replace authority.
Excluded installations retain live native handles and cached full object IDs, preventing rename-based state admission.
Windows state and existing writer files require current-user/SYSTEM-only ACLs; Unix root0700/file0600 require the current owner. No ACL or mode rewrites.
File flush is paired with held-directory fsync and Darwin device full-sync or Windows native write-through creation.
Darwin absent ACL semantics and variadic ARM64 openat permissions are verified against Apple sources and real file modes.
Ancestor policy is refreshed through held identities and reverse parent/child relations; bounded retries repeat all policy inspection after unrelated generation races.
Cancellation is checked immediately before native creates and between bounded exclusion comparisons.
A borrowed CLOEXEC writer handle avoids advisory-lock inheritance into child processes; independent reproduction and regression prove the release.
Native link blobs have explicit blobBytes separately from comparison byte accounting.
CLI exact selection rejects ambiguous flags and resolves relative paths against the captured working directory.

durabilityContract: Verified OS publication calls and restart-visible journals; no globally atomic transaction against external managers/same-UID adversaries or unconditional storage hardware power-loss guarantee.

firstCI.windowsFinding: The test assumed a parent directory move always succeeds despite its exclusive archive handle. Both native refusal and detected movement are valid safe outcomes; regression corrected without weakening the evidence requirements.
